name: Ploughing
overview: Scripture presents ploughing as both a literal agricultural practice and a rich spiritual metaphor. It involves careful, sustained labor, often performed with oxen as seen in the accounts of Elisha and Job, and is subject to divine instructions such as the prohibition against yoking an ox and an ass together. Spiritually, ploughing symbolizes the breaking up of sin and affliction, with the principle that those who 'plow iniquity' will reap its consequences, calling believers to repentance and devotedness. The imagery underscores the necessity of attentive, consistent effort in both physical and spiritual cultivation.
